title: Getting into and out of bed

scenes.caption: Check what feels suitable for you
scenes.narration_line: If you are unsure about a movement, ask your midwife or physiotherapist before trying it.

scenes.caption: Rest on your side with support
scenes.narration_line: Rest on your side; try a pillow between your knees and a small one beneath your bump.
safety_points: Avoid long periods lying flat on your back.

scenes.caption: Roll shoulders, hips and knees together
scenes.narration_line: To get out, roll onto your side, moving your shoulders, hips and knees together.

scenes.caption: Lower legs while pushing up with arms
scenes.narration_line: Ease your legs off the bed while your arms push you into sitting, as one coordinated movement.

scenes.caption: Reverse the movement to get into bed
scenes.narration_line: To get into bed, reverse the movement: lower onto your side while bringing your legs onto the bed.
